nodes.name: Ni underlayer electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: A thin Ni under layer was initially deposited over the copper substrate in a Ni deposition bath by applying a constant cathodic current density of 50 mA cm⁻² for 585 s (~10 μm thicknesses) (Cu/Ni).
nodes.source_text: a thin Ni under layer was initially deposited over the copper substrate in a Ni deposition bath by applying a constant cathodic current density of 50 mA cm⁻² for 585 s (~10 μm thicknesses)

nodes.name: NiZn bilayer electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Then, a top and thicker NiZn bilayer with increasing Zn content from bottom-to-top was electrochemically deposited by applying the same current density for 2300 s (~40 μm thicknesses) (Cu/Ni/NiZn). All of the parameters and conditions for fabrication of the activated Cu/Ni/NiZn electrode were described elsewhere in details [19].
nodes.source_text: a top and thicker NiZn bilayer with increasing Zn content from bottom-to-top was electrochemically deposited by applying the same current density for 2300 s

nodes.name: Alkaline leaching activation
nodes.procedure: The Cu/Ni/NiZn electrode was treated to 30% NaOH, and Zn was chemically dissolved from the surface that leads to numerous cracks and pores.
nodes.source_text: The Cu/Ni/NiZn electrode was treated to 30% NaOH, and Zn was chemically dissolved from the surface

nodes.name: Gold spontaneous deposition
nodes.procedure: The alkaline leached Cu/Ni/NiZn electrode was finally treated to a gold deposition bath with the chemical composition of 1.5 mM KAuCl₄ + 0.1 M HCl for 600 s, and its surfaces were chemically modified by spontaneous deposition of Au.
nodes.source_text: The alkaline leached Cu/Ni/NiZn electrode was finally treated to a gold deposition bath... for 600 s, and its surfaces were chemically modified by spontaneous deposition of Au

nodes.description: HER activity, electrochemical stability, and corrosion behaviour evaluation in 1 M KOH at 298 K
nodes.source_text: The HER activity and corrosion behaviour of the electrodes were examined in 1M KOH solution at 298K. The current-potential (E-i) and semi-logarithmic current-potential curves (E-log i) of the working electrodes... Some electrochemical parameters such as current density at -1.250V (i−1.250), cathodic Tafel slope (bc), charge-transfer coefficient (α), exchange current density (io) and overpotential at 100mAcm−2 cathodic current density (η100) were determined... A constant -100-mV overpotential was applied... for 86400s... The polarization resistances... were calculated as 91, 64 and 351Ω cm², respectively.
